content.value: . A flat-plate collector of 5 m² in area is tested to measure the overall heat loss coefficient. Water at 65°℃ circulates through the collector at a flow rate of 0.05 Lit/sec. The ambient temperature is 8°C and the exit temperature is 50°C. Determine the overall heat loss coefficient. Assume there is no incident solar radiation.
